title: Tampered Memory Elephant Random Walk on One-Dimensional Integer Lattice
summary: One of the outstanding questions in the theory of elephant random walks as observed by Gut and Stadtmüller (2023), is to determine how much memory is needed for a phase transition between the diffusive, critical and superdiffusive regimes to persist. To investigate this memory breakpoint, we introduce the tampered memory elephant random walk, in which the memory is partitioned into two disjoint sets $D_n$ and $D_n^c$, which may be deterministic or random.
